title: Collapse of a single-column total
statement: For an integer cochain complex T [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], the collapse map from the total complex of its degree-zero single column [def-sc-preorder-bar-total] to T is an isomorphism of cochain complexes.

source.place: The source-bar, finite-cone-block, least-block adjunction and union-bar paragraphs; Collapse of a single-column total.

proof.text: In total degree n the column-zero diagonal inclusion is inverse to collapse. Every summand in a positive horizontal degree is a zero object because the single-column complex vanishes there. Total-generator extensionality gives the other inverse identity. The resulting degreewise isomorphisms imply an isomorphism of complexes.
